ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$. Draw a perpendicular line from point $A$ to $BC$ with the foot of the perpendicular being point $E$. Extend $BC$ to point $F$ such that $CF=BE$. Connect $DF$. Prove that the quadrilateral $AEFD$ is a rectangle.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since $CF=BE$, \\
it follows that $EF=BC=AD$, \\
and since $EF\parallel AD$, \\
it implies that quadrilateral $AEFD$ is a parallelogram, \\
since $AE\perp EF$, \\
it follows that $\angle AEF=90^\circ$, \\
therefore, the quadrilateral AEFD is a \boxed{rectangle}.

From the image, read that B, E, C, F are collinear in that order, with E on BC and F beyond C, and that AE is perpendicular to the line BC/EF. From the text, use that ABCD is a rhombus and CF = BE. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中 ABCD 是一个菱形，A 在左上方，B 在左下方，C 在下方偏右，D 在右上方；B、E、C、F 在同一直线上，且顺序为 B、E、C、F，F 是把 BC 向右延长后的点。AE 从 A 垂到直线 BC/EF，在 E 处有直角标记，表示 AE ⟂ BC。图中还画出了 DF，并画有菱形的对角线 AC、BD 交于 O。

推理：因为 E 在 B、C 之间，F 在 C 的延长线上，所以 EF = EC + CF。已知 CF = BE，因此 EF = EC + BE = BC。又因为 ABCD 是菱形，所以 AD = BC，且 AD ∥ BC。由于 EF 与 BC 在同一直线上，所以 EF ∥ AD，并且 EF = AD。因此，在四边形 AEFD 中，一组对边 EF 与 AD 平行且相等，所以 AEFD 是平行四边形。又因为 AE ⟂ BC，而 EF 与 BC 共线，所以 AE ⟂ EF，即 ∠AEF = 90°。有一个角为直角的平行四边形是矩形，因此四边形 AEFD 是矩形。

method.method_draft: Prove both pairs of opposite sides of AEFD are parallel by a congruent-triangle argument. From the image, read that B, E, C, F are collinear, AE is perpendicular to BC at E, and sides AB and CD of the rhombus are parallel in the same slant direction. From the text, use that ABCD is a rhombus and CF = BE. In the rhombus, AB = CD and AB ∥ CD. Since BE and CF lie on the same line BC, the included angles ∠ABE and ∠DCF are equal. With AB = CD and BE = CF, triangles ABE and DCF are congruent by SAS. Therefore ∠DFC equals ∠AEB. Since ∠AEB = 90° because AE ⟂ BC, it follows that DF ⟂ CF, hence DF ⟂ EF. Also AE ⟂ EF, so AE ∥ DF. Meanwhile AD ∥ BC in the rhombus, and EF lies on BC, so AD ∥ EF. Thus AEFD has both pairs of opposite sides parallel, so it is a parallelogram; with AE ⟂ EF, it is a rectangle.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中 A、B、C、D 构成一个菱形，A 在左上方，B 在左下方，C 在下方偏右，D 在右上方；BD 与 AC 相交于 O。B、E、C、F 在同一直线上，F 是从 BC 向右延长得到的点；从 A 向 BC 作垂线，垂足为 E，图中在 E 处标有直角符号。AB 与 CD 是菱形的对边，在图中呈相同的斜向并互相平行；AD 与 BC 也互相平行。推理：因为 ABCD 是菱形，所以 AB = CD，且 AB ∥ CD。又由题意 CF = BE，并且 B、E、C、F 共线，所以 BE 与 CF 在同一直线方向上。由于 AB ∥ CD，BE 与 CF 共线，可得夹角 ∠ABE = ∠DCF。于是，在三角形 ABE 和三角形 DCF 中，有 AB = CD，BE = CF，且 ∠ABE = ∠DCF，所以 △ABE ≅ △DCF，依据 SAS。由全等三角形对应角相等，得 ∠AEB = ∠DFC。又因为 AE ⟂ BC，且 E 在 BC 上，所以 ∠AEB = 90°。因此 ∠DFC = 90°，即 DF ⟂ CF。因为 E、C、F 共线，EF 与 CF 在同一直线上，所以 DF ⟂ EF。同时 AE ⟂ BC，而 EF 也在 BC 这条直线上，所以 AE ⟂ EF。于是 AE 和 DF 都垂直于 EF，因此 AE ∥ DF。另一方面，在菱形 ABCD 中 AD ∥ BC，而 EF 是 BC 所在直线的一部分，所以 AD ∥ EF。由此，四边形 AEFD 的两组对边分别平行：AE ∥ DF，AD ∥ EF，所以 AEFD 是平行四边形。又因为 AE ⟂ EF，平行四边形 AEFD 有一个直角，所以 AEFD 是矩形。

method.CoT_answer_check_final: 先描述图像：图中 A、B、C、D 构成一个菱形，A 在左上方，B 在左下方，C 在下方偏右，D 在右上方；BD 与 AC 相交于 O。B、E、C、F 在同一直线上，F 是从 BC 向右延长得到的点；从 A 向 BC 作垂线，垂足为 E，图中在 E 处标有直角符号。AB 与 CD 是菱形的对边，在图中呈相同的斜向并互相平行；AD 与 BC 也互相平行。推理：因为 ABCD 是菱形，所以 AB = CD，且 AB ∥ CD。又由题意 CF = BE，并且 B、E、C、F 共线，所以 BE 与 CF 在同一直线方向上。由于 AB ∥ CD，BE 与 CF 共线，可得夹角 ∠ABE = ∠DCF。于是，在三角形 ABE 和三角形 DCF 中，有 AB = CD，BE = CF，且 ∠ABE = ∠DCF，所以 △ABE ≅ △DCF，依据 SAS。由全等三角形对应角相等，得 ∠AEB = ∠DFC。又因为 AE ⟂ BC，且 E 在 BC 上，所以 ∠AEB = 90°。因此 ∠DFC = 90°，即 DF ⟂ CF。因为 E、C、F 共线，EF 与 CF 在同一直线上，所以 DF ⟂ EF。同时 AE ⟂ BC，而 EF 也在 BC 这条直线上，所以 AE ⟂ EF。于是 AE 和 DF 都垂直于 EF，因此 AE ∥ DF。另一方面，在菱形 ABCD 中 AD ∥ BC，而 EF 是 BC 所在直线的一部分，所以 AD ∥ EF。由此，四边形 AEFD 的两组对边分别平行：AE ∥ DF，AD ∥ EF，所以 AEFD 是平行四边形。又因为 AE ⟂ EF，平行四边形 AEFD 有一个直角，所以 AEFD 是矩形。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, in rhombus $ABCD$, diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ intersect at point $O$. Draw a perpendicular line from point $A$ to $BC$ with the foot of the perpendicular being point $E$. Extend $BC$ to point $F$ such that $CF=BE$. Connect $DF$. Prove that the quadrilateral $AEFD$ is a rectangle.
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since $CF=BE$, \\
it follows that $EF=BC=AD$, \\
and since $EF\parallel AD$, \\
it implies that quadrilateral $AEFD$ is a parallelogram, \\
since $AE\perp EF$, \\
it follows that $\angle AEF=90^\circ$, \\
therefore, the quadrilateral AEFD is a \boxed{rectangle}
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, ABCD is a rhombus, A is at the upper left, B is at the lower left, C is toward the lower right, and D is at the upper right; B, E, C, F are on the same straight line, and the order is B, E, C, F, with F being the point obtained by extending BC to the right. AE drops perpendicularly from A to the straight line BC/EF, and there is a right-angle mark at E, indicating AE ⟂ BC. DF is also drawn in the figure, and the diagonals AC and BD of the rhombus are drawn and intersect at O.

Reasoning: Because E is between B and C, and F is on the extension of C, EF = EC + CF. It is known that CF = BE, therefore EF = EC + BE = BC. Also because ABCD is a rhombus, AD = BC, and AD ∥ BC. Since EF and BC are on the same straight line, EF ∥ AD, and EF = AD. Therefore, in quadrilateral AEFD, one pair of opposite sides EF and AD are parallel and equal, so AEFD is a parallelogram. Also because AE ⟂ BC, and EF is collinear with BC, AE ⟂ EF, that is, ∠AEF = 90°. A parallelogram with one angle being a right angle is a rectangle, therefore quadrilateral AEFD is a rectangle.
